opening.argument: The presentation promotes paid OneCoin packages as the route to obtaining mined tokens, expressly telling viewers to consider “when you buy these packages.” It presents the €5,500 Tycoon package as a path to projected coin quantities and escalating monetary values, potentially turning that payment into hundreds of thousands of euros; indeed, “if you go for tycoon this is where the real game begins.” The message adds a multi-generation commission structure—“you make 10% from your first generation”—and creates urgency by suggesting “the right time was when initially they started,” while encouraging package purchases or holding coins for a projected €100 value. Finally, it directs viewers to register for “a FREE OneCoin account.” These are sales and recruitment instructions, not neutral cryptocurrency education.
